name: ORO AI
long_description:
We're building the open benchmark for commerce.

Builders submit shopping agents. Independent validators run them against problems that change daily. The best agent earns the rewards, and every run becomes training data.
one_liner: Continuously improving evals for agentic commerce

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Founder at ORO AI. 

Previously founding engineer at Crucible Labs, scaling Crucible Wallet from 0 to $3.5M AUM in 3 months. 

Before that, was at AWS Cloud Map, helping scale API throughput 4x. 

Computer Science @ University of Toronto, early undergrad researcher, working on evals for distributed training. Co-President at UofT AI, running the largest undergrad ML competition in 2021 to model climate change, secured $100k+ in grant funding from Google, DeepMind, IBM, Accuweather, etc.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
Founder at ORO AI.

Previously Senior Software Engineer at AWS, leading distributed systems projects across ECS and AWS Cloud Map.

Earlier, co-founded HomeWurk, building a two-sided marketplace for local services. Targeting low skilled contract work for high school and university students to make extra money while in school.

Software Engineering degree from University of New Brunswick.
